name: EDGE 5W-30 LL
forCars: VW group cars on long-life service, plus BMW, Mercedes and Porsche models that need these approvals. Petrol, diesel and hybrid.
blurb: Castrol's top full synthetic for long-life servicing. Castrol says its Fluid Titanium technology helps keep metal parts apart under pressure.
label: #1f5a3a

name: Quartz INEO Long Life 5W-30
forCars: VW group cars on long-life service, petrol and diesel, plus BMW and Mercedes models that need LL-04 or 229.51.
blurb: TotalEnergies built this low-ash oil for Volkswagen group engines, to look after the exhaust clean-up kit, particulate filters most of all.
label: #f2efe6

name: Triple R 5W-30 for VW
forCars: Recent VW, Audi, SEAT and Skoda petrol and diesel cars, including long-life service, plus BMW and Mercedes models that need LL-04 or 229.51.
blurb: Carlube's highest VW-spec 5W-30. A low-ash full synthetic that Carlube says is made for maximum protection and better fuel economy.
label: #2f7fc0

name: Fully Synthetic 5W-30 for BMW
forCars: Modern BMW, Vauxhall, VW and Mercedes petrol and diesel cars that need a C3 5W-30. Not for VW long-life service, which needs 504 00 / 507 00.
blurb: A low-ash full synthetic from Redex in one 2-litre bottle that covers BMW, Vauxhall, VW and Mercedes specs.
label: #5b5fae

name: MAGNATEC 5W-30 A5
forCars: Ford petrol and diesel cars that call for Ford WSS-M2C913-D. Not for cars with a diesel particulate filter.
blurb: Castrol says its molecules cling to engine parts even after the oil drains down, cutting wear during warm-up and stop-start driving.
label: #e9efe9

name: Triple R 5W-30 for Ford
forCars: Ford petrol and diesel engines (Duratec, Duratorq, Zetec) that need Ford WSS-M2C913-D, and older Fords that need -A, -B or -C.
blurb: Carlube says it meets and beats Ford's 913-D spec, with over 3% better fuel economy in the CEC M111 test.
label: #6b8f3a

name: Syner-G 5W-40
forCars: Petrol and diesel cars that call for an A3/B4 5W-40, such as VW 502 00 / 505 00 and Mercedes 229.3. Not a low-ash oil.
blurb: Comma's high-performance 5W-40 for petrol and diesel engines, with official VW and Mercedes approvals.
label: #c8202f

name: Quartz 9000 5W-40
forCars: Turbo and direct-injection petrol and diesel cars that call for an A3/B4 5W-40, such as VW 502 / 505, Mercedes 229.5 and BMW LL-01. Not a low-ash oil.
blurb: TotalEnergies says it resists breaking down well enough for long service intervals and copes with hard driving all year round.
